entries.reason: THE INSTANCE THIS CHECK WAS BUILT FOR, carried only long enough to land the check that finds it. `charts.gabe565.com` is a third-party PERSONAL chart repository. It is still alive -- it publishes `adguard-home` actively -- and simply stopped updating its headscale chart on 2025-02-19. The consequence is not a stale version string: the chart pins the appVersion, so we run headscale v0.25.0 while the project shipped v0.29.3 on 2026-07-29. Four server releases of fixes that cannot reach us through this coordinate, while the pin resolves, the chart renders, and the currency report says 0 behind. MEASURED 2026-09-02: headscale ships NO official Helm chart -- the project repo carries `packaging/` and `nix/` but no chart, and its README never mentions Helm -- so every option is a third-party packager and 'relocate to the official chart' is not available. That makes this a real migration decision (best-maintained community chart vs. in-repo manifests over the project's own container image), which is why it is filed rather than done inside a currency sweep.
